displayDescription.en:
Sequence labeling systems such as hidden Markov models modeled how observations were generated, which made overlapping and long-range input features awkward to use. Conditional Random Fields instead modeled the label sequence directly given the observed sequence.

A CRF assigns a globally normalized conditional probability to an entire label sequence using feature functions over observations and neighboring labels. Dynamic programming supports exact inference and training for linear-chain models. Experts generally regard CRFs as a foundational discriminative model for structured prediction. They became standard for named-entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging, segmentation, and hybrid neural-CRF systems.
displayDescription.zh:
隐马尔可夫模型等序列标注系统需要建模观测如何生成，因此难以灵活使用重叠特征和长距离输入特征。条件随机场改为在给定观测序列的条件下直接建模标签序列。

CRF 使用观测和相邻标签上的特征函数，为整条标签序列分配全局归一化的条件概率。在线性链模型中，动态规划支持精确推断和训练。专家通常把 CRF 视为结构化预测的基础判别模型。它曾成为命名实体识别、词性标注、序列分割以及神经网络—CRF 混合系统的标准方法。
